description: Compare the prices of a product category or a specific model across merchants (France on comparr.fr, United States on comparr.co). Returns ranked products with every offer, the exact seller, the item condition and the date each price was checked. If no comparison exists yet, one is started and the result has status 'pending' with retry_after_seconds: the full results are available about 60 seconds later for the same query.

max_price.description: Optional budget in the market currency (EUR or USD). Products whose best price is above it are left out.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in their own words (e.g. "casque bluetooth réduction de bruit", "Dyson V8").

name: search_products
title: Rechercher et comparer des produits
